// Generated by Cairntrace `cairn export playwright`. Edit at your own risk —
// re-running export will overwrite. Source: <unknown>
// Intent: export widget steps and interaction flags
// Lang: ts

import { expect, test, type Page } from "@playwright/test";

// Cairntrace widget runtime (set / check / choose / form): the in-page drivers
// `cairn run` uses, with the project's browser.fieldRoot / browser.widgets.
const CAIRN_WIDGETS_PREFIX = "<widget runtime prefix>";
const CAIRN_WIDGETS_SUFFIX = "<widget runtime suffix>";
const CAIRN_WIDGETS_CONFIG = {};
// Like `cairn run`: a password control or a credential-named field never puts its values in an error.
const CAIRN_WIDGETS_SENSITIVE = /pass(?:word|wd|code|phrase)|pwd|secret|token|credential|otp|cookie|authorization|api[_-]?key|jwt|bearer/i;

interface CairnWidgetResult {
  ok: boolean;
  status: string;
  driver?: string;
  error?: string;
  sensitive?: boolean;
  actual?: unknown;
  label?: unknown;
  matches?: boolean;
  results?: CairnWidgetResult[];
  unanswered?: unknown[];
}

/** Run one widget op in the page; throws when it did not commit. */
async function cairnWidget(page: Page, input: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<CairnWidgetResult> {
  const script = CAIRN_WIDGETS_PREFIX + JSON.stringify({ timeoutMs: 10000, readBackMs: 2000, ...input, config: CAIRN_WIDGETS_CONFIG }) + CAIRN_WIDGETS_SUFFIX;
  const result = (await page.evaluate(script)) as CairnWidgetResult;
  if (!result || !result.ok) {
    const hidden = (result && result.sensitive === true) || CAIRN_WIDGETS_SENSITIVE.test(JSON.stringify(input.target ?? ""));
    throw new Error("cairn widget " + String(input.op) + " failed: " + (hidden ? "values hidden (sensitive field)" + (result && result.driver ? " — " + result.driver : "") : result && result.error ? result.error : "no result"));
  }
  return result;
}

interface CairnFormField {
  key: string;
  value: unknown;
  optional?: boolean;
  dependsOn?: string[];
  driver?: string;
  timeoutMs?: number;
}

/** Cairntrace form: ordered fields, dependsOn mount waits, a final re-read of every field. */
async function cairnWidgetForm(page: Page, fields: CairnFormField[], options: { verify: boolean; dumpUnanswered: boolean; timeoutMs: number }): Promise<void> {
  const skipped = new Set<string>();
  const written: Array<{ target: { field: string }; value: unknown; label?: unknown; driver?: string }> = [];
  try {
    for (const field of fields) {
      const dependsOn = field.dependsOn ?? [];
      if (dependsOn.some((dep) => skipped.has(dep))) {
        skipped.add(field.key);
        continue;
      }
      const budget = field.timeoutMs ?? options.timeoutMs;
      const result = await cairnWidget(page, {
        op: "set",
        target: { field: field.key },
        value: field.value,
        timeoutMs: budget,
        mountMs: field.optional && dependsOn.length === 0 ? Math.min(budget, 750) : budget,
        verify: options.verify,
        ...(field.optional ? { optional: true } : {}),
        ...(field.driver ? { driver: field.driver } : {}),
      });
      if (result.status === "skipped") {
        skipped.add(field.key);
        continue;
      }
      written.push({ target: { field: field.key }, value: field.value, label: result.label, driver: result.driver });
    }
    if (options.verify && written.length > 0) {
      const reread = await cairnWidget(page, { op: "readMany", timeoutMs: 5000, targets: written });
      (reread.results ?? []).forEach((entry, index) => {
        if (!entry.ok || entry.status === "absent" || entry.matches === false) {
          const key = written[index]!.target.field;
          const shows = entry.sensitive === true || CAIRN_WIDGETS_SENSITIVE.test(key) ? "[redacted]" : JSON.stringify(entry.actual);
          throw new Error("form field " + JSON.stringify(key) + " lost its value after later fields were set (shows " + shows + ")");
        }
      });
    }
  } catch (error) {
    if (!options.dumpUnanswered) throw error;
    const dump = await cairnWidget(page, { op: "dump", timeoutMs: 5000, limit: 50 }).catch(() => undefined);
    throw new Error((error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)) + "; unanswered fields: " + JSON.stringify(dump?.unanswered ?? []), { cause: error });
  }
}

test("golden_widgets", async ({ page }) => {
  // Derived from sequential step/outcome budgets (+10% headroom, at least 1m); 4h ceiling.
  test.setTimeout(375000);

  // --- steps ---
  // step: go
  await page.goto("https://example.com/form");
  // step: country
  await cairnWidget(page, { op: "set", target: { "field": "country" }, value: "Spain", timeoutMs: 10000, mountMs: 10000 });
  // step: contact
  await cairnWidget(page, { op: "set", target: { "locator": { "by": "label", "name": "Contact" } }, value: { "query": "Ada", "option": "Ada Lovelace" }, driver: "vue-multiselect", timeoutMs: 15000, mountMs: 15000 });
  // step: terms
  await cairnWidget(page, { op: "check", target: { "field": "terms" }, timeoutMs: 10000, mountMs: 10000 });
  // step: no_news
  await cairnWidget(page, { op: "uncheck", target: { "field": "services" }, option: "News", timeoutMs: 10000, mountMs: 10000 });
  // step: owner
  await cairnWidget(page, { op: "choose", target: { "field": "owner" }, option: "No", optional: true, timeoutMs: 10000, mountMs: 750 });
  // step: answers
  await cairnWidgetForm(page, [
    { key: "setup", value: "Shared entity" },
    { key: "entity_code", value: "C100", dependsOn: ["setup"] },
    { key: "start_date", value: "today" },
    { key: "products", value: ["Widget A", "Widget B"] },
    { key: "legacy", value: "No", optional: true },
  ], { verify: true, dumpUnanswered: true, timeoutMs: 10000 });
  // step: start
  if (await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Start" }).first().isVisible().catch(() => true)) {
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Start" }).first().click();
  }
  // step: save
  try {
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Save" }).first().click({ timeout: 5000 });
  } catch (pointerError) {
    // pointer blocked or not actionable: fall back to a DOM click (Cairntrace fallback: dispatch)
    await cairnWidget(page, { op: "click", mode: "dispatch", target: { "locator": { "by": "role", "role": "button", "name": "Save" } }, mountMs: 5000 });
  }
  // step: close
  await cairnWidget(page, { op: "click", mode: "dispatch", target: { "locator": { "by": "selector", "selector": ".close" } }, mountMs: 5000 });
  // step: address
  await cairnWidget(page, { op: "fill", target: { "locator": { "by": "label", "name": "Address" } }, value: "10 Main Street", mountMs: 5000, verify: true, settleMs: 500, attempts: 4 });
  // step: referral
  if (await page.getByLabel("Referral").first().isVisible().catch(() => true)) {
    {
      for (let fillAttempt = 0; ; fillAttempt++) {
        await page.getByLabel("Referral").first().fill("SPRING");
        await page.waitForTimeout(500);
        try {
          await expect(page.getByLabel("Referral").first()).toHaveValue("SPRING", { timeout: 500 });
          break;
        } catch (err) {
          if (fillAttempt >= 3) throw new Error("hydration wiped value after 4 attempts", { cause: err });
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // --- outcomes (the contract) ---
  // saved: saved
  await expect(page.locator("body")).toContainText("Saved", { ignoreCase: true, useInnerText: true });

});
